about.label: About
about.headline: From Biology to Code, From Lab to Product
about.p1: I'm a Biomedical Engineer finishing my degree at UNC Córdoba, specializing in AI for medical imaging. My thesis — TraumaVision — is a clinical decision support system that detects fractures in X-rays with 97.18% accuracy.
about.p2: In 2025 I founded Eleven, an AI-first digital agency. We build web products and AI agents for SMBs. It runs on Next.js, Claude API, and GSAP — the same stack I use for everything.
about.p3: Two seasons working ski resorts in California. Funded my own degree. First place, Rocking the Industry hackathon — 40 engineers, real industrial problems, 2025.
about.p4: Cross-disciplinary isn't a weakness. It's the feature.
